### `prepareRealmForgeConstructionPresetPhysics(snapshot, { assemblyResourceId = null, resolveProduct = null, resolveMaterial = null, resolveJointProfile = null, resolveModulePackage = null, maximumShapesPerBody = undefined, } = {})`

Project one semantic modular assembly into the existing construction-island graph and strict PhysX descriptors. The document is never mutated: every brick, board, fastener, and chair component retains its stable identity.
